headline: Adding semantic detection to the schema+statistical baseline improves adjusted F1 by 0.2339 +/- 0.0025 (B3 0.7606 +/- 0.0069 -> B4 0.9945 +/- 0.0055, 30.7% relative), with 100.0% of the adjusted recall gain concentrated in semantic-specific drift subtypes — corroborating the isolated Semantic Blind-Spot Recovery = 1.0 result from Phase 8 using independent evidence (raw F1: B3 0.6457 +/- 0.0100 -> B4 0.9055 +/- 0.0177, delta 0.2598 +/- 0.0156).

subtype_recompute.note: B3 per-subtype recall recomputed from cached per-window decisions (rows.csv); B4 recompute validated against cached aggregate_subtype_recall.csv

lag.note: lag structurally ~0; only nonzero lags are B4-only detections, see lag.csv and nonzero_lag_streams

novelty: Ablation re-presents existing Phase 7 multi-seed results; no new experiment, windows, or seeds were created.
